purpose: Provide real OS process separation between the existing tokenless CVH02 learned policy and a finite public consequence channel, without first use of any genuine external source world.

source.all_test_sources: source-free mocked public toy process; NOT original causal environment and no upstream package import

hypothesis: A source-side subprocess communicating through an exact binary public-event JSON-lines IPC can execute source-free policy actions without handing the source object, privileged metadata, unselected labels, or uncertain-effect replay to CVH02's model; reject tampering, reordering, wrong action and unsafe continuation.

implementation.scope: research/contrib/chatgpt/CVH-04/** only plus independent generated-only G29 on separate exact source child
implementation.process: short-lived OS subprocess launched only by explicit test invocation; no scheduler, owner loop, daemon, background work, local runner, network or original environment access
implementation.source: toy_source_child.py, deterministic unrelated binary mock with one episode and private-only hidden variable, toy seed IDs 1..6
implementation.parent: public_ipc.py using existing CVH02 PublicEarnedPolicy and inherited independent CVH01 conventional batch baseline; exact public tuple fields and source-observation order
implementation.wire: JSON line version v1 exact keys, max 6 actions, 4096 bytes per event, strict int-not-bool validators, opaque source PID kept outside model; timeout/error closes and never replays
implementation.event_flow: policy chooses using only previous public records -> explicit source action -> validates six-field returned consequence -> policy observes only validated event; no source-private info
implementation.test: source-free two subprocesses per toy pair, same source public seeds for cold-replay and uninterrupted, compare checkpoint, action/reward transcript SHA, independent batch returns, process IDs distinct, intentionally malformed/wrong-action/private data/duplicate rejection, refused protected original seed, guaranteed source-first-use disabled

science.claim: ENGINEERING_SOURCE_FREE_PROCESS_SEAM_ONLY; synthetic mock tests cannot support scientific gains

exit_criteria: If inherited qualified adapter/policy cannot be connected across OS subprocess while preserving public-only action consequence protocol, report engineering fail and stop; no source first-use to work around it.
